scope: Additional manually authored local challenges evaluated after the diagnostic fixes. Not an independent or representative holdout: written by the same developer, with no scraped ground-truth corpus. Tests contextual negation, unsupported aliases, paraphrases, and keyword competition. Do not combine into a production accuracy estimate.

classification.title: Shared symbols
classification.statement: Find the longest common subsequence of both strings; the symbols need not be contiguous.

classification.title: Robot movement
classification.statement: Avoid blocked cells; compute the minimum jumps needed to reach the destination.

classification.title: Optimal score
classification.statement: Maximize the score of a sequence of choices.

classification.title: Longest Common Subsequence
classification.statement: Example input includes the words LIS and Fibonacci.

classification.title: Label lookup
classification.statement: Locate the identifier LCS in the dictionary.

classification.title: Longest Palindromic Substring
classification.statement: Find the longest contiguous palindrome in a string.

classification.title: Longest Palindromic Subsequence
classification.statement: Maximize the length of a palindromic sequence after deleting characters.

classification.title: Weighted tree selection
classification.statement: Choose an independent set of maximum weight.

classification.title: Unbounded Knapsack
classification.statement: Example: contrast with 0/1 knapsack where repetition is forbidden.

classification.title: Word histogram
classification.statement: Count input words. Example words: longest common subsequence, edit distance, knapsack.

classification.title: Zero-one Knapsack
classification.statement: Choose items at most once under a capacity.

classification.title: Maximum tree depth
classification.statement: Return the depth of the deepest node.

classification.title: Reachable vertices
classification.statement: Determine whether a directed path exists from source to destination.

classification.title: Text conversion
classification.statement: Return the smallest number of character insertions deletions and substitutions needed to transform a source into a target.

query.title: Shared symbols
query.statement: Find the longest common subsequence of two strings; characters need not be contiguous.

target.title: LCS
target.statement: Return the length of a common subsequence of greatest length.

query.title: Longest Palindromic Subsequence
query.statement: Find the longest subsequence reading the same forwards and backwards.

target.title: Symmetric subsequence
target.statement: Delete any characters to obtain the longest palindrome and return its length.

query.title: Pair target
query.statement: Return indices of one pair summing to a target.

target.title: Pair target
target.statement: Count all pairs summing to a target.

query.title: Edit Distance
query.statement: Find the minimum number of edits to transform the source string into the target.

target.title: Text conversion
target.statement: Return the fewest insertions deletions and substitutions converting one string to another.

query.title: Tree DP
query.statement: Choose nonadjacent nodes of a tree to maximize weight.

target.title: Weighted independent set
target.statement: Select tree nodes with no adjacent pair, maximizing the total weight.

query.title: Target pair
query.statement: Return two indices whose sum equals target. Background vocabulary: satellite orbit telemetry altitude fuel pressure velocity acceleration coolant thermodynamics compass navigation latitude longitude gyroscope payload trajectory horizon capsule atmosphere ignition thruster.

target.title: Find pair
target.statement: Find two indices with values whose sum is target.
